name: Sign-up rejects invalid input without creating an account

planSteps.description: Open https://muster.orazen.online/sign-up in a fresh unauthenticated browser context. Do not start Google login or submit a well-formed email address.
The heading is Create your account. Your name, Email address, password and Create account controls are present, with a Sign in link back to /sign-in.
Enter Synthetic QA as the name, not-an-email as the email and a synthetic 16-character password, then click Create account.
Browser email validation rejects the malformed address, no signup request is sent, the user remains on /sign-up and no account or session is created.
Replace the password with a short value while keeping the invalid email, then submit again.
The form remains invalid and unauthenticated; no signup request is sent. This test does not establish successful signup or closed-signup server acceptance.
